title: Automated Legacy Refactoring for FinTech Systems
business: Financial institutions maintaining monolithic legacy codebase architectures.
problem: High operational risk and developer fatigue during manual migration of deprecated API calls within massive, undocumented codebases.
solution: Utilizing the GPT-5-Codex model via the Responses API to perform automated, agentic refactoring by analyzing existing code structures and injecting modern, secure API patterns.
steps: Ingest legacy repository documentation and source code into the GPT-5-Codex context window.
Define function calling schemas to map deprecated legacy methods to new secure endpoints.
Invoke the Responses API to generate iterative refactoring patches based on the defined schemas.
Validate generated code patches through automated unit testing pipelines.
Commit verified refactored modules back to the version control system.
outcome: Increased developer velocity and reduced technical debt through consistent, automated application of modern coding standards across legacy modules.
limitation: The model may occasionally hallucinate logic in highly non-standard custom frameworks; verify by checking the diffs against existing unit test coverage before merging.
